text: Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. One-page site with menu and prices, hours, location and pre-order for pickup. Rule: the page must load fast on a phone, speed matters more than visuals. We'd love a full-screen background video of our coffee being brewed.

@Requester The charter leaves out these items from your brief: Full-screen background video of coffee being brewed: dropped because it conflicts with the Requester's own rule that speed matters more than visuals, and a full-screen video is the heaviest thing a phone would load. If a brew video is wanted later, it can only be a tap-to-play element that loads nothing until tapped, and that needs a new charter decision.. Work starts after your answer.

   Option 2: Drop them

proposal.name: Single-file mobile page with menu, hours, location
proposal.goal_gap: No site file exists (site_versions is 0). Menu, hours and location sections are missing.
proposal.expected_outcome: One HTML file with inline CSS and JS, a viewport meta tag and a phone-width layout. It has a menu where every item shows a price, a seven-day hours list, and a location section naming Indiranagar, Bengaluru with a placeholder address and map link. No external fonts or blocking scripts. All unsupplied facts are visibly marked [PLACEHOLDER].
proposal.completion_check: File has a viewport meta tag. Menu items each show a price (real or [PLACEHOLDER]). Hours cover Monday to Sunday. Location text names Indiranagar, Bengaluru and has an address and a map or directions link, as real values or marked placeholders. No external font or blocking script tag. No image without lazy loading and size attributes.

proposal.name: Pickup pre-order form
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot order ahead for pickup.
proposal.expected_outcome: A pre-order section in the same file. The visitor picks menu items, enters a name and a pickup time, and submits. The order goes to a stated destination, shown as a marked placeholder (for example a WhatsApp number). Pickup time rules are also a marked placeholder.
proposal.completion_check: Section has item selectors, a name field, a pickup time field and a submit control. The destination is stated in the page text and marked [PLACEHOLDER]. Submitting with empty name or time is blocked. No script runs network requests on page load.

proposal.name: Tap-to-play brew video
proposal.goal_gap: The brew video the Requester wanted is not on the page, and the charter allows it only as tap-to-play.
proposal.expected_outcome: A brew video block with a visible play button and a video element with preload="none" and no autoplay attribute. The source URL is set by JS only after the tap, and full-screen on play is allowed. The video file is a marked placeholder.
proposal.completion_check: Video element has preload="none", no autoplay attribute and no src or source URL in the initial HTML. A play control exists. The source is assigned only inside the tap handler. The video file is marked [PLACEHOLDER] in the page text.
